t.zh: 到这里，任务都是由物体求像。反过来：看到一个像有多高，能说出物体多高、多远吗？
t.en: So far every task has gone from the object to its image. The other way round: from how tall an image is, can you tell how tall and how far the object is?

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：哪些物体会成一样高的像？f = 2，每一轮给出几组（物高, 距离），选出至少两组：每组的像高都是 1，距离各不相同。
t.en: This level asks: which objects image equally tall? With f = 2, each round lists several (height, distance) pairs; choose at least two that all image 1 tall, no two at the same distance.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="scale-ambiguity"></wiki-ref>：物高和距离同比放大，像一点不变。一张像只定下 H/Z，大而远和小而近分不出来。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="scale-ambiguity"></wiki-ref>: scale an object's height and distance together and its image does not change. An image fixes only H/Z; big and far cannot be told from small and near.

brief.zh: f = 2：选出像高都是 1、距离各不相同的两组以上。
brief.en: f = 2: choose two or more pairs that all image 1 tall, at different distances.

hint.zh: 像高 h = fH/Z。物高和距离一起翻倍，h 怎样变？
hint.en: The image height is h = fH/Z. When height and distance both double, what happens to h?

prompt.zh: 哪几组的像高都是 1、距离又各不相同？
prompt.en: Which pairs all image 1 tall, at different distances?

prompt.zh: 换一批：哪几组的像高都是 1、距离又各不相同？
prompt.en: Another set: which pairs all image 1 tall, at different distances?

why.zh: 挑了一样高的物体：可像高还取决于距离，高 2 的箱子在距离 2 处成的像高 2。成一样高的像的，是 H/Z 相同的那些。
why.en: That picks objects of one height, but the image also depends on distance: the crate 2 tall at distance 2 images 2 tall. Equal images come from equal H/Z.
